description:
### Release v3.16.4

- **Fix About Page & Clipboard Enhancements on 18.5.4**: Added 18.5.4 version preference key support (`0x7f140b30`) with ExtendedPreference fallback to resolve `Could not find the 18.0.3 version preference in res/xml/setting_about.xml`.
- **Dual 18.0.3 & 18.5.4 Compatibility**: Full patch support for 25 core patches on both 18.0.3 and 18.5.4.
